data.name: Sajili
data.long_meaning: Sajili is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sajjili' which means 'wisdom', 'learning' or 'knowledge'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture, representing the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name is also associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning.
